memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Asthma with intermittent wheeze and nocturnal cough, insomnia with difficulty falling asleep, vitamin B12 deficiency with mild fatigue.
Symptoms: episodic dyspnea on exertion, night-time awakenings, daytime somnolence. Examination: mild expiratory wheeze bilaterally, normal vitals, BMI 24 kg/m2.
Spirometry: FEV1 2.10 L (68% pred), FVC 2.80 L (82% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.75; post‑bronchodilator FEV1 2.30 L (+0.20 L change).
Asthma Control Test score 16 (not well controlled). Insomnia Severity Index score 14 (moderate insomnia).
Technique checked: correct for salbutamol MDT inhaler; inspiratory flow adequate for dry powder device.
Smoking: never.
Plan: continue salbutamol SOS, start budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD, montelukast 10 mg HS, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD. Review in 3 months.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Asthma: improved control, occasional rescue use. Insomnia: persistent sleep onset difficulty. Vitamin B12: still low despite supplementation.
Symptoms: wheeze twice weekly, night-time cough 1‑2 times/week, takes 30‑45 min to fall asleep, fatigue mild.
Exam: mild end‑expiratory wheeze, otherwise clear lungs.
Spirometry: FEV1 2.25 L (73% pred), FVC 2.90 L (85% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.78; change since last +0.15 L.
Asthma Control Test score 19 (borderline not well controlled). Insomnia Severity Index 13 (moderate).
Technique checked: correct; dry powder inspiratory flow adequate.
Smoking: never.
Plan: increase budesonide-formoterol to 400/12 mcg inhaler BD, add montelukast continue, melatonin continue, consider reducing trazodone to 25 mg HS, continue methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD. Review in 3 months.

Winter exacerbation of asthma, insomnia stable, B12 adequate.
Symptoms: increased wheeze with cold exposure, rescue inhaler use 3‑4 times/week, nocturnal cough 2 nights/week, sleep latency unchanged.
Exam: mild bilateral wheeze, good air entry.
Spirometry: FEV1 2.15 L (70% pred), FVC 2.85 L (84% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.75; change since last –0.25 L.
Asthma Control Test score 17 (not well controlled). Insomnia Severity Index 9 (mild).
Technique checked: correct; dry powder inspiratory flow adequate.
Smoking: never.
Plan: increase budesonide-formoterol to 400/12 inhaler BD plus add a short course of oral prednisolone 20 mg daily for 5 days (outside routine meds), continue salbutamol SOS, montelukast HS, melatonin HS, trazodone 25 mg HS, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD. Review in 1 month.
